items.title_zh: 脑机接口监管情报追踪器
bullets_zh: 用于收集和可视化脑机接口相关法律/监管法规的GitHub项目。
提供采集器与界面，追踪合规相关的监管动态。
可作为非侵入式BCI监管情报来源，而非器械营销宣传。
bullets_en: GitHub project for collecting and visualizing legal/regulatory acts related to brain-computer interfaces.
Provides a collector and UI for tracking compliance-relevant regulatory developments.
Relevant as non-invasive BCI regulatory intelligence rather than device marketing claims.

items.title_zh: 脑机接口神经反馈认知康复训练
items.title_en: Cognitive Rehabilitation Using Neurofeedback With Brain-computer Interface
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT07828496测试BCI神经反馈训练对认知结局的影响。
该试验使用EEG指标作为儿童青少年认知障碍的客观标志物。
发布于2026-09-18，为非侵入式临床BCI康复提供证据。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT07828496 tests a BCI neurofeedback training program for cognitive outcomes.
It uses EEG-based measures as objective markers of cognitive impairment in children and adolescents.
Published 2026-09-18; relevant to non-invasive clinical BCI rehabilitation evidence.

items.brief_en: Non-invasive EEG BCI neurofeedback trial evaluating cognitive rehabilitation in children and adolescents.
